decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed development would result in an increased built footprint on
the site, which lies within Surface Water Flood Zones 3a and 3b, as well as
Fluvial Flood Zone 3. As such, the site is highly vulnerable to flooding. The
submitted Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) fails to provide sufficient information
to demonstrate that the development would not increase flood risk on or off
site. In the absence of this critical information, the proposal fails to
demonstrate compliance with national and local flood risk and drainage policies
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies CS1.B of the Harrow Core
Strategy (2012), DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management and&nbsp; Policy</span>&nbsp;CN3 from the emerging Harrow Local Plan (Regulation 19).</p>

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed development, due to its infilling of garden space with a
single-storey link extension, increased built form, and associated alterations
including an enlarged dormer, upward-protruding rooflights, and potential
boundary enclosures, would result in a loss of openness and harm the verdant,
low-density character of the site and wider South Hill Avenue Conservation
Area. The development would fail to preserve or enhance the character and
appearance of the conservation area, contrary to the aims of the South Hill
Avenue Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (CAAMS), which
identifies garden infill and insensitive alterations as key threats. The
proposal lacks clear and convincing justification for the harm caused and would
be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies CS1.B of
the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), DM1 and DM7 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013), and South Hill Avenue Conservation Area
Appraisal and Management Strategy&nbsp;</span><span arial="">and&nbsp;</span>Policies GR1, GR6, HE1(d)(a)(b) from the emerging Harrow Local Plan (Regulation 19).</p>
description:
Reduction of front porch, Alterations to roof of side extension to raise height, Single and two storey
side to rear extension, Single storey side to rear extension to link main dwelling to outbuilding,
Alterations to roof to replace tiles and enlarge side dormers,  Replacement cladding to side dormers and first floor front and rear elevations, Replacement windows and door in front elevation,
Replacement windows in side elevation, Installation of doors in side elevation, Installation of Juliette
balcony in rear end gable, Installation of sliding gate to boundary wall, Raised patio and balustrade to
rear, External alterations (Demolition of rear extension)
